from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, Descriptors
import numpy as np, pyscf
from pyscf import gto, scf, dft
smi='C1OC2C1C3OCC2O3'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
print('Formula:', Descriptors.MolWt(m), Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=20250308, useRandomCoords=True)
print('Embedding status:', status)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m, maxIters=1000)
conf=m.GetConformer()
atoms=[]
for a in m.GetAtoms():
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
    atoms.append((a.GetSymbol(), (p.x,p.y,p.z)))
print('Atoms:', len(atoms))
print('PySCF version:', pyscf.__version__)
mol=gto.M(atom=atoms, basis='6-31g*', charge=0, spin=0, unit='Angstrom', verbose=0)
print('Electrons:', mol.nelectron, 'AO:', mol.nao_nr())
method=dft.RKS(mol)
method.xc='B3LYP'
method.conv_tol=1e-9
method.max_cycle=100
energy=method.kernel()
mo=method.mo_energy
occ=method.mo_occ
occ_idx=np.where(occ>0)[0]
vir_idx=np.where(occ==0)[0]
ih=occ_idx[-1]; il=vir_idx[0]
print('SCF converged:', method.converged)
print('Total electronic energy (Ha):', f'{energy:.12f}')
print('HOMO index:', int(ih), 'energy (Ha):', f'{mo[ih]:.12f}')
print('LUMO index:', int(il), 'energy (Ha):', f'{mo[il]:.12f}')
